trigger: Reviewed small32K Online attention median0.9726384699489709 exceeds M6 threshold0.20; this is not a DRAM traffic measurement.
scope: One isolated synthetic decode candidate; no production cache/API/default change, cross-layer activations or intervening engine kernels, cache-write cost, model/task quality, application admission or end-to-end performance claim.

representation.layout: Separate K/V. Original Half [kv_heads, capacity, head_dim]. Codes same logical order, even index in low8 bits and odd index in high8 bits of u16. Scales [kv_heads, capacity, head_dim/32], stored as Half bits. No padding inside payload.
representation.partial_groups_and_byte_tails: Excluded by exact component geometries; every row is a multiple of32 and every packed pair complete.
representation.scale: For a finite group, maxabs/127 rounded once to nearest-even Half. All-zero group uses positive-zero scale and all-zero codes. Nonzero group whose rounded scale is zero uses minimum positive Half subnormal (bits1).
representation.codes: Divide original exact stored Half value by the stored rounded Half scale in FP32; nearest-even integer rounding, clamp[-127,127]. Store signed two's-complement byte. Reserved-128 rejected; negative/nonfinite scales and nonzero codes with zero scale rejected.
representation.reconstruction: Signed code converted to FP32 times exact stored Half scale converted to FP32. No subsequent Half cast; independent FP64 attention oracle consumes these exact FP32 reconstructed inputs.
representation.quantization_error: Record max/RMS reconstruction error and clamped-value count separately from unchanged FP64-oracle arithmetic envelope. A rounded-down scale can clamp extrema.
representation.validation: CPU pack_group validates all timed resident codes/scales before submission; owned buffers remain immutable. Timed GPU loader is a compile-time trusted specialization. A separate checked diagnostic specialization rejects malformed GPU data; malformed-buffer rejection is not a property of the trusted path.

inputs: Deterministic distinct per-layer finite Half Q/K/V; identical original inputs feed FP16 baseline and quantized candidate. Every layer owns distinct K/V allocations and content, all layers resident simultaneously. No full CPU clones or reconstructed caches.
execution: One ordinary serial compute encoder per layer in one command, same tracked output allocation overwritten by every layer (WAW dependence), one completed wait per sample; status atomics are not the serialization mechanism. Retained resources and no CPU mapped access while in flight. Same queried width, dispatch count and Safe/Precise Metal2.3 policy. Baseline is unchanged production AttentionDecode kernel.
correctness: Untimed independent FP64 oracle checks every layer/output for FP16, trustedI8 and checkedI8. Frozen1e-4+1e-3*abs(expected) arithmetic envelope; finite/status/guards/input immutability required. Exact256GPUFP32-bit reconstruction values across bothI8specializations cover canonical zero, minimum-subnormal scales, signed code extremes and maximumfiniteHalfscales; bounded attention-level zero/extreme cases complement them. CPU golden cases cover sign/packing/ties/zeros/subnormals/clamp/reserved/nonfinite rules. Format-invalid diagnostic status is2; NaNquery status is3 (mass+output).
memory: Count simultaneous FP16/I8/scales, all layers/queries, shared output/status, guards, bounded host oracle/packing storage, driver and framework allowance. Admission and conservatively summed owned native lifetime peaks must each fit6GiB. No model weights loaded in this component; actual application qualification is separate.
decision: A negative result can reject this frozen candidate and retain FP16. A positive component result cannot adopt I8 without complete engine integration/cache-write/state/quality/end-to-end gates. Preserve all samples; do not relax gates to make it pass.
